notes: A short test of the engine, not a piece for the game: a spring morning in D, rising to F sharp in bar 4 and settling on a suspension (D to C sharp over A); A' answers lower and closes on the third; the optional B darkens through a borrowed G minor 6 over D (B flat sinking to A); the coda closes plagally. Phrases of 5, 6, 5 and 3 bars. Section A has a written left hand; the rest let the engine voice the chord symbols. Quotes nothing known: plain stepwise diatonic lines over common modal progressions.
